title: The Switch is OpenPak's home network
body: The Switch is where OpenPak lives today. A retail console creates a profile, links it to an OpenPak account, sees friends and plays online with no Nintendo service and no third-party network in the path. Dozens of Switch games are live or in beta testing, each with its own channel in this app, and the News you are reading runs on the same network. If you own a Switch, this is your network: the one that already works, with the other consoles following behind it.
footer: OpenPak — open network services for your console.
